intermediate.name: Góra Św. Anny
intermediate.title: KOM Sprint (2) Góra Św. Anny (40.4 km)

story: Five attackers formed the early breakaway with a maximum gap of 3:30, controlled by XDS Astana. Dries de Bondt regained the KOM jersey lead. Cavagna and Gamper later joined, but the break was caught on the final Kocierz ascent. Neilson Powless attacked; Jan Christen launched a decisive move in the final 2 km and won the sprint against Marco Brenner.
